Subject: Activate your TakeProfit account
Preheader: Verify your email to activate your TakeProfit account.
Trigger: User signs up / email needs verification

Subject: Reset your TakeProfit password
Preheader: We received a request to reset your password for your TakeProfit account.
Trigger: User requests a password reset

Subject: Set a new password to link your exchange account
Preheader: To authorize your login through a linked exchange account, use the reset link in this email.
Trigger: User links an exchange account (needs password set)

Subject: Set a new password to link your Google account
Preheader: To authorize your login through a linked Google account, use the reset link in this email.
Trigger: User links a Google account (needs password set)

Subject: Set a new password and link your accounts
Preheader: Set a new password to link your accounts and authorize your login.
Trigger: User links accounts (combined flow, needs password set)

Subject: Your indicator is under review
Preheader: We are currently auditing your logic for stability and publication readiness. Expect the verification process to be completed within 2-4 business days.
Trigger: User submits an indicator for review

Subject: Your indicator has been approved 🎉
Preheader: Great news! Your indicator is now live.
Trigger: Moderator approves indicator (with comment)

Subject: Your indicator has been approved 🎉
Preheader: Great news! Your indicator is now live.
Trigger: Moderator approves indicator (no comment)

Subject: Your indicator wasn't approved
Preheader: Thank you for your submission. After careful review, we couldn't publish your indicator as it doesn't meet our requirements.
Trigger: Moderator rejects indicator

Subject: We've received your report
Preheader: Thank you for helping us keep the TakeProfit community safe.
Trigger: User submits a report

Subject: Update on your report
Preheader: We have reviewed your report regarding a post or comment in the TakeProfit Community.
Trigger: Moderator reviews a submitted report

Subject: Your content violates our Community Guidelines
Preheader: We reviewed your recent post or comment and determined that it violates the TakeProfit Community Guidelines.
Trigger: Moderator flags user content as violating guidelines

Subject: {username} commented on your post
Preheader: {username} commented on your post.
Trigger: Someone comments on the user's post

Subject: {username} replied to your comment
Preheader: {username} replied to your comment.
Trigger: Someone replies to the user's comment

Subject: {username} started following you
Preheader: {username} just followed you.
Trigger: Someone follows the user

Subject: New from {creator}: {Content_title}
Preheader: A new {post/indicator/screener} from a creator you follow is live on your feed.
Trigger: Followed creator publishes a new indicator

Subject: {creator} shared subscriber-only content
Preheader: A new {post/indicator/screener} from a creator you follow is live on your feed.
Trigger: Followed creator posts subscriber-only (locked) content

Subject: New from {creator}: {Content_title}
Preheader: A new post from a creator you follow is live on your feed.
Trigger: Followed creator posts; recipient follows but isn't a paid subscriber

Subject: {creator} just posted: {Content_title}
Preheader: A new post from a creator you follow is live on your feed.
Trigger: Followed creator posts; recipient is a paid subscriber

Subject: You've got a new subscriber 🎉
Preheader: @{subscriber_username} subscribed to your {indicator} {indicator_name}.
Trigger: Someone subscribes to the user's paid content

Subject: Subscription renewed — {amount} earned
Preheader: @{subscriber_username} renewed their subscription for {content}.
Trigger: A subscriber renews their subscription

Subject: Referral earnings — {amount}
Preheader: Your referral @{referral_username} renewed their subscription.
Trigger: A referred user renews their subscription

Subject: Your first subscriber is in! 🎉
Preheader: Your first subscriber is in! Your first payout is approaching.
Trigger: User gets their first paid subscriber

Subject: Welcome to TakeProfit
Preheader: Welcome to TakeProfit — let's get you started.
Trigger: User completes signup

Subject: Alert: {ticker} {source} {condition} {value}
Preheader: Your alert triggered your criteria.
Trigger: A single-criterion price/indicator alert fires

Subject: Alert: {ticker} {source} {condition} {value}
Preheader: Your alert triggered {N} of your criteria.
Trigger: A multi-criteria alert fires
